example_sentences_in_bangla: কি বলতে চাইছো একবর্ণও বুঝতে পারলাম না।
তার বক্তৃতা একবর্ণও মনে পড়ছে না।
example_sentences_in_english: I didn't understand even a single word of what you're saying.
I don't remember even a bit of his speech.
note: Refers to the basic unit of writing in Bengali script, emphasizing complete incomprehension.
